selected_batch.rationale: The bounded mandatory fixed additional-token, ordinary Fabricate, single-permanent Explore, ordinary Proliferate, intrinsic entry including represented prospective Planeswalker and Battle tokens, fixed player, fixed positive ordinary-mana and fixed positive life cumulative-upkeep, normalized controller life-gain and draw-trigger, and closed public permanent-entry and creature-death counter-trigger families are capability-closed through shared replacement-aware transactions. Cumulative upkeep commits its age-counter replacement result before calculating payment, token creation exhausts additional-token choices before its simultaneous intrinsic-counter batch, player-result triggers consume public committed events, and zone-change triggers consume immutable current or last-known public facts before their counter bodies enter the canonical transaction. The remaining dependency-ready CR 614.16 boundary is counter-producer migration: loyalty costs, remaining rule-generated producers, and unsupported optional, variable, movement, prevention, subtype-qualified, aggregated, or linked families must enter typed resumable owners rather than bypassing replacement ordering. This remains a producer-ownership harvest, not a claim that aggregate replacement effects, Cumulative Upkeep, Fabricate variants, simultaneous Explore, or every event-trigger family is complete.
